text.text: Windows gaming refers to computer games designed for Microsoft's Windows operating systems. The platform became a major gaming environment through widespread hardware availability, DirectX development tools, and support from many publishers. Windows libraries include a wide range of genres from strategy and simulation to first-person shooters and role-playing games. Popular titles include Doom, Warcraft, Half-Life, The Sims, Age of Empires, and countless modern PC releases.
